The app has to make sure every collection is assigned and confirmed.

proposals.statement: The app must allow drivers to accept jobs, mark collections, take photos of waybills, and get signatures.

evidence.quote: Accept the job, mark it collected, take a photo of the waybill, and get a signature.

proposals.statement: The app must work offline and send data when the driver is back in range.

evidence.quote: It has to work offline and send everything when they're back in range.

proposals.statement: The app must work with Android smartphones, as most drivers use them.

evidence.quote: Most have Android phones, their own. I think they all do, but I'd have to check.

proposals.statement: The app must integrate with the tracking system from the vendor and the invoicing system on Sage.

evidence.quote: Our trucks have a tracking system from a vendor, so we can see where they are. And invoicing runs on Sage.

proposals.statement: The client expects the consultant to show the MD a budget figure by the end of January.

evidence.quote: I'd want to show her a figure by the end of January.

proposals.statement: The app must work with the depot's network, which is unreliable in Bloemfontein during load-shedding.

evidence.quote: Bloemfontein goes down during load-shedding because the router isn't on the backup battery. That should be fixed, but it isn't yet.

proposals.statement: The use of drivers' locations as personal information is an open question.

evidence.quote: Have you checked how you're allowed to use them?

proposals.statement: The app should eventually provide clients with a tracking link, similar to a courier service.

evidence.quote: Eventually our clients should get a tracking link, like a courier. But not now.

proposals.statement: The app should support Afrikaans to cater to half of the drivers' language preference.

evidence.quote: And Afrikaans in the app. Half my drivers would prefer it.

proposals.statement: The app will start with a pilot at the Bloemfontein depot due to its challenging conditions.

evidence.quote: My suggestion is to start with a pilot at the Bloemfontein depot, since it has the hardest conditions.
